name: Moxisylyte

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1993 — for liver harm

summary: Moxisylyte was pulled from the market in France, beginning in 1993, due to liver harm [3]. In addition, a small computer model evaluated the drug rather than tests on people [M]. This computer model gave the drug low scores for both liver and heart risks [M].
